rationale: The agent performed an order-changing action (initiated a return) without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing write. It also ignored the user’s stated preference for refund to credit card and processed a gift card refund without stating that a credit card refund was impossible or seeking consent to switch methods. Additionally, the agent asserted a specific refund amount ($989.70) without visible tool output supporting that figure. While the agent did attempt basic authentication (find by name and ZIP) and operated on what appear to be the user’s orders, the lack of confirmation, deviation from the requested refund method without justification, and inclusion of an unsupported amount mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
